current_authorization.description: Current session and centralized study authorization precede every lookup and delivery; reauthorize before dispatch/publication/cache/byte delivery. Native receipts are never access grants.

scope_association.description: Match public resource, exact study, native store and node against authoritative association; unknown and foreign IDs are indistinguishable.

revision_cas.description: For a new command only, actual current revision must equal expected_revision; refusal leaves state and witnesses unchanged.

canonical_command_digest.description: Bind canonical complete command to actor/study/operation/reserved IDs/store; same ID changed payload conflicts, multiple witnesses stay uncertain.

span_bounds_and_hash.description: Require 0 <= start < end <= exact artifact codepoint length; same version/extraction/artifact/hash, safe known PDF page inventory, derived line labels, server UTF-8 slice/hash. Convert browser UTF-16 indices.

byte_length_and_hash.description: Count original/chunk/extracted/decoded bytes, validate all SHA256 values and offsets, contiguous complete upload; no Content-Length trust. Output utf8_bytes matches encoded text.

delete_fences.description: One app transaction reserves exact source set and blocks new citations/configuration/approach/export/membership admissions; inspect non-head/pending/uncertain usages. Native serialized closure recheck precedes deletion. Uncertain outcomes retain fence.

replay_before_visibility_and_cas.description: Authorize then exact immutable witness lookup before active visibility/CAS. Exact historical outcome never reactivates terminal collection. Zero witness permits retry only after the prior writer is proven absent.

terminal_integrity.description: Empty terminal Group, revision and immutable witness commit atomically. Reject missing/malformed lifecycle/witness, nonempty terminal, conflicting receipts. Native active filtering precedes pagination/counts/search.

publication.description: Publish exact result only after category-specific app transaction proof for metadata/archive or native witness/readback/byte proof for native categories. Match category, reserved IDs, scope and revisions. Operation is not a scientific run; never optimistic timeout retry.

cursor_binding.description: Opaque signed cursor binds current scope/query/filters/revision; reject invalid/deleted collection filter without broadening; authorize counts/snippets.

parser_containment.description: Fixed image/config, strict UTF8/newline policy and real native input/output provenance; external resource limits applied before parsing. Finished wrapper does not imply successful extraction.

portable_closure.description: Explicit selection only, typed role inventory; reject missing/extra paths/hashes, traversal/symlink/zip bombs/unknown binary, credentials and executable checkpoints. Native import remains data-only and quarantined until destination authorization/full closure.

backup_barrier.description: Verified empty destination and coordinated generation covers all app/native/scientific/annotation/citation/import/export writers; partial copy is unusable. Imported witnesses are origin data, never destination command authority.

bridge_isolation.description: Read loop fixed verbs only, write mode single-writer; neither launches science. No app/model profile/launcher/socket credentials. Handle is server-resolved scoped expiring transfer, never a filesystem path.

creation_identity.description: App reserves collection_id/annotation_id once; exact internal input, result, association and immutable witness reserved IDs must agree with the durable operation. Never accept these IDs in public create bodies or allocate replacements on replay.

extraction_lineage.description: Initial kind requires create request and null retry_of. Retry kind requires retry request with exact prior_attempt_id matching authorized route, same original/policy, eligible predecessor and new command/attempt; retained attempt retry_of and exact witness result preserve predecessor. Match request command_id to identity and never resume automatically.

commit_authority.description: Metadata/archive mutation, revision CAS and immutable DocumentAppCommit1 receipt commit in the same app transaction; recover exact identity/digest/reserved IDs/result/revisions from that transaction before current CAS. Native categories require exact DocumentNativeWitness1 and store/association/byte checks. Labels alone are not proof. Wrong authority/category or conflicting receipts stay uncertain; missing receipt permits explicit retry only after correct writer fencing and absence proof.

extraction_reconciliation.description: Uncertain attempt changes only after verifying exact retained original/config/process/result links, IDs and bytes/manifest hashes; result outcome must equal destination including unsupported/needs_transcription. Finished wrapper alone is not proof. No result/conflicts remain uncertain; never create an attempt or retry on read.

public_integrity.source: same authorized History.read result; not stored history or digest material

commit_barrier.rule: Current authorization, exact preview/context/parent checks and all-source reservation under the same app write transaction as evidence/configuration/approach/export publication. Deletion-pending or uncertain sources refuse new references; retained references block source deletion.

$comment: Authored Documents definitions and registry. Order groups follow their named model definition. The execution schema is generated; never edit it by hand.
